Let \(\left( z_{1}, \ z_{2}\right)\) be two non-zero complex numbers. Among the following formulas which ones are are true?
  • . \(Arg(3 i)\equiv -\pi/2\mod 2\pi\)
  • . \(Arg(z_1/z_2)\equiv Arg(z_1) - Arg(z_2) \mod 2\pi\)
  • . \(Arg(1) \equiv 0 \mod 2\pi\)
  • . \(Arg(z_1/i) \equiv Arg(z_1) - \pi/2 \mod 2\pi\)
